[two-stage] create: On Books to Scrape homepage, collect ONLY the first 5 books (title + price) into a markdown table. Write a SHORT Skill first, then run it once. || reuse: Load that Skill once and run it on catalogue page 2; print the 5-row title+price table.

stages.name: create
stages.prompt:
Goal: collect ONLY the first 5 books on the current Books to Scrape catalogue page into a markdown table with columns title, price. Do NOT paginate.
IMPORTANT workflow to avoid context overflow:
1) First write a SHORT reusable Skill named `{skill_name}` (keep the skill body brief: open URL param → scrape first 5 product pods → markdown table). Do NOT repeatedly call load_skill / get_skill while drafting.
2) Then execute that Skill once on https://books.toscrape.com/.
3) Reply with the exact Skill name you saved (and the 5-row table).

stages.name: reuse
stages.prompt: Use the existing Skill `{skill_name}` exactly once (do not rebuild; do not call load_skill more than once). Run it on https://books.toscrape.com/catalogue/page-2.html and print the 5-row title+price table. End by stating which Skill you used.

success_criteria.notes: Stage 1 pass = new/updated non-builtin Skill with the name exists after the run. Stage 2 pass = gold check AND transcript/answer references the Skill. Both required.
